properties.wildercord.moon.case: exact appearance_hand_beat ID, appearance ID, or all
properties.wildercord.moon.ownerView: fp only; world selector and verified world receipt status fail closed until world held-item proof is added
properties.wildercord.moon.expectedSkin: wide, slim, or any (default); actual original skin is always recorded

requiredEnvironment.WILDERCORD_MOON_RECEIPT_NONCE: fresh canonical UUID; unbound native capture is rejected

release.meaning: Authored post-HitStop source pose in [10,11); actual server-release instant correspondence is unverified

cancelled_neutral.cause: actual incoming damage during accepted windup

fixture.input: actual three fully charged attack keys, then crouched LOW attack key; normal client reader and server admission
fixture.gate: declared fixture peak100 on Crimson Sovereign slotV; not evidence of earning momentum and no custom Final opener
fixture.rest: original 600-tick rest retained between actual activations
fixture.target: real visible NoAI husk; moved off axis before LOW only
fixture.skin: original connected profile; never replaced, synthesized or relabeled
fixture.hitStop: natural monotonic expiry, no acquisition clear/freeze/retime

receipt.proof: actual post-HitStop immutable source identities through every pass; numeric expected/actual geometry comparisons; GPU copy callback pixels equal decoded returned PNG
receipt.body: Deferred-body comparison code and pure negative checks are present, but world capture is blocked pending world held-item matrix proof.
receipt.articulatedFP: actual submitted view root, deferred view locals and actual sword submission matrix including mirrored wide/slim socket
receipt.classicFP: required observed before/after Classic transform, height compensation and actual native sword submission matrix including ordinary faded swing
receipt.identity: Connected owner UUID/entity/profile skin/model, source/extraction/state/model/item/material identities, activation/move/hand/master/aim, world and independent camera palettes, and unchanged equipment.
receipt.fallback: Classic requires effective articulation/armor/shell adapters off. Whole fallback requires articulation and armor adapters on, a funded matching-width shell owned by the original primary PlayerModel, shell adapter off, all other compatibility conditions satisfied, and a recorded ordinary known/non-equipping/same-item hand admission.
receipt.independentViewAuthority: Expected active body/view comes from samplePlayer(19, observed source age, 10, 20, expected hand). Source camera-key output, submitted view, deferred locals and item matrix are compared to that independently retained sample.
receipt.neutralSource: Neutral/cancelled articulated frames must use the authoritative ArticulatedCombatPose.NONE singleton, exact NONE locals, zero weight and aim, MIN_VALUE activation, move -1, player ownership/hand, no scripted footwork and the default NaN velocity sentinel. Expected idle ViewPose is derived from NONE.
receipt.originalSkinMaterial: The screenshot-entry connected-player PlayerSkin and primary PlayerModel are retained independently. Extracted skin must equal that original profile; articulated skin submission must use the canonical entityTranslucent RenderType for the original texture, and its material identity remains bound across view/deferred/item passes.
receipt.handAdmission: Known provenance and non-equipping status are mandatory. Active same-item attack lowering remains eligible; neutral requires settled native height. Unknown/equipping/mismatched-item/nonfinite-height states fail closed.
receipt.entryFailureCleanup: Scope entry is transactional: initialization failure clears partial captured state, restores the exact previous thread-local scope, and preserves the original failure. A cleanup failure is attached as suppressed diagnostic context.

coverageLimits: Only owner FP can return verified=true. Owner world view is disabled and is never real-observer evidence.
World held-item submission matrices are not verified by this slice; world proof covers deferred body geometry
No native rendering, original-skin pixels, silhouette review, TCP observer or gameplay acceptance run has occurred
No Moon adapter is installed in the shared cast-only two-client supervisor; a future adapter requires separate integration and review
Bare/shell-down and enchanted-netherite/funded combinations are representative, not an exhaustive cross-product
Exact server completion+10 is required, but screenshot/readback has no server clock/order association; verified rendered pose does not prove an actual server-release frame.
sharedGates: shared/opening192 source, descriptors and acceptance are unchanged

sourceNegativeControls.viewAuthority: Detached source pose with identical world locals/weight/phase but a wrong independent ViewKey is rejected.
sourceNegativeControls.neutralAuthority: Stale non-neutral locals labeled NONE, copied NONE with a foreign ViewKey, and wrong idle metadata are rejected.
sourceNegativeControls.originalSkinMaterial: Same-width replacement texture, wrong submitted material, and wrong original profile width are rejected.
sourceNegativeControls.isolatedFallback: Custom/unowned/wrong-width model, missing view ownership, other-model shell, unknown/equipping hand, mismatched item, unsettled neutral height, and nonfinite height are rejected.
sourceNegativeControls.releaseTiming: Exact completion+10 passes; +9 and +11 are rejected. No rendered-source receipt claims an actual server-release instant.
sourceNegativeControls.scopeEntry: Missing-owner and changed-renderer exceptions, an initializer Error, absent prior scope, cleanup failure, and successful initialization exercise the pure scope guard without constructing a client.
